scripts.build: npm run build -w @justai/shared && npm run build -w @justai/server && npm run build -w @justai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @justai/server && npm run typecheck -w @justai/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @justai/server && npm test -w @justai/web
scripts.eval: npm run build:shared && npm run eval -w @justai/server --
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @justai/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @justai/web
